Oracle Fusion Procurement 26D: what's new

26D is the next Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update. Oracle's 26D What's New documents for this area list 91 features: 14 on by default, 23 on by default with potential setup, 40 setup required, 12 opt-in, 2 needing another action, per Oracle's "Action to Enable" column. See all 91 →

We track 25 Procurement changes in 26D, out of 91 features (our count) in Oracle's 26D What's New documents for this area. 25 of them are delivered switched on; 0 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Oracle sources: Procurement 26D What's New · Self Service Procurement 26D What's New

Impact ratings are our editorial view of how much a change affects day-to-day users and testing. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Delivered switched on (25)

Handle date changes in contract lines as inline updates in purchase agreements

Impact: highAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · External Purchase Prices
The Import Purchase Agreements from External Purchase Prices scheduled process can now handle start or end date changes in contract lines as inline updates to corresponding Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPAs).
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Add payment details with a new address or site

Impact: mediumAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · Supplier ModelRedwood Platform
The feature Redwood: Manage Supplier Profile is now enhanced to allow adding payment details on new supplier addresses and sites. When you create an address or site, you can also add related bank accounts, payment methods, and payment attributes as part of this update.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Enhance lifecycle management for intake requests

Impact: mediumAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · Common ProcurementRedwood Platform
Improve visibility and control over intake requests with return and resubmit capabilities, template updates, and tracking document history. Requesters can change the template for draft or returned requests; the application creates a new request with the selected template and cancels the original request.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Manage contract user variable values in purchasing documents

Impact: mediumAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform
Allow buyers to enter, update, and view contract user variable values for purchase orders, purchase agreements, and their change orders when using terms templates from Enterprise Contracts.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Process multiple purchasing document actions in real time

Impact: mediumAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform
Process selected actions on purchasing documents in real time when the number of selected records is within the processing limit. Before this update, when you performed any action by selecting more than 1 purchase order or purchase agreement, the action was processed using a scheduled process.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Retain column personalizations for table layouts on Sourcing pages

Impact: mediumAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · SourcingRedwood Platform
Retain table column personalizations made through the table organizer on Sourcing pages. These personalizations include showing, hiding, and reordering columns.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Retain column personalizations for table layouts on Supplier Model pages

Impact: mediumAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · Supplier ModelRedwood Platform
Retain table column personalizations made through the table organizer on Supplier Model pages. These personalizations include showing, hiding, and reordering columns.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Retain column personalizations for table layouts on Supplier Qualification Management pages

Impact: mediumAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · Supplier Qualification ManagementRedwood Platform
You can now retain table column personalizations made through the column organizer on Supplier Qualification Management pages. Column personalizations include showing, hiding and reordering columns.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Search purchase agreement lines while viewing or editing purchase agreements and change orders

Impact: mediumAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform
Search purchase agreement lines using a new user experience when viewing or editing purchase agreements or their change orders. You can use keyword search and filters to quickly find matching lines in large purchase agreements, helping you locate information more efficiently.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Search purchasing documents by contract number

Impact: mediumAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform
Search purchasing documents by contract number to improve contract visibility and make it easier to identify documents backed by a procurement contract. The Contract attribute is now displayed in the search results, helping buyers and suppliers quickly identify contract-backed purchasing documents without opening each record.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Selected Contracts Bug Fixes in This Update

Impact: mediumAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · Procurement Contracts
This update includes some bug fixes that can change the way the application works. This isn't a full list of all the bug fixes in this update.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Split budget-controlled requisition lines that aren't charged to projects

Impact: mediumAutomatically onProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform
Split requisition lines that are subject to budgetary controls or encumbrance accounting provided that the requisition isn't charged to a project. As a buyer, when you take this action, the application creates new requisition lines, copies the original line data, unreserves funds on the original line, and attempts to reserve funds on the new lines.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

View negotiation and award approval history

Impact: mediumAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · SourcingRedwood Platform
View approval history during negotiation and award approval using the Redwood experience. This provides greater transparency into approvers, approval actions, comments, and status changes.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Display detailed error messages in requisition approvals

Impact: mediumAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform Idea Lab
You can now see more detailed error messages when you view approver information for a requisition. When approver information isn't available, the application explains the reason and tells you what to do next.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Display intake request number on requisition lines

Impact: mediumAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform
For requisitions created from intake requests, you can access the originating request while reviewing requisition information. This provides easy access to the original request and its context.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Create intake requests for procurement contracts

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · Common ProcurementRedwood Platform
Create intake requests for procurement contracts by configuring intake request templates with the procurement contract outcome. Configure the template controls that are relevant to your contract process, including contract type, primary party, payment terms, commercial terms, and contract dates.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Manage negotiation templates

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · SourcingRedwood Platform
Manage supplier negotiation templates in the Redwood experience. From the Negotiation Templates search page you can review templates, as well as create, update, and activate draft templates using a guided process.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Search and filter requisition lines, purchase orders, and purchase agreements using descriptive flexfields

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · PurchasingRedwood Platform
Search and filter results using descriptive flexfield segments on Process Requisitions, Purchase Orders and Purchase Agreements pages for buyers and suppliers using the new user experience.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Simulate award scenarios in the Sourcing Command Center

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementProcurement · SourcingFusion Claw
Use the award simulator in the Sourcing Command Center app to generate award scenarios based on your enterprise sourcing award policies. Apply your preferred scenario to finalize the award and create outcome documents.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Create intake requests for procurement contracts

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Common ProcurementRedwood Platform
Create intake requests for procurement contracts by configuring intake request templates with the procurement contract outcome. Configure the template controls that are relevant to your contract process, including contract type, primary party, payment terms, commercial terms, and contract dates.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Display line type when viewing requisition lines

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform Idea Lab
Requesters and preparers can now view the line type, such as Goods and Services, from both the Lines view of the My Requisitions page and the Lines table on the Requisition Details page.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Manage catalog administration tasks using a new user experience

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform
As a catalog administrator, you can now manage catalog administration tasks from a centralized Catalog Administration landing page. You can review recently modified catalogs, quickly access frequently used setup tasks, search for catalog objects, and personalize the landing page with KPIs and visualizations.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Manage catalogs

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)ProcurementSelf Service Procurement · Self Service ProcurementRedwood Platform
As a catalog administrator, you can now manage local, punchout, and informational catalogs using a new user experience. Access the new user experience to manage catalogs
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source
